governance_body: Emirati Genome Program (EGP) & DoH Genomics Committee

rules.recommended_action: Refer to certified Medical Geneticist or Genetic Counselor for secondary finding disclosure
rules.clinical_rationale: Pathogenic genomic variant in ACMG SF v3.2 actionable gene requires certified counselor disclosure and cascade testing plan.
rules.source_guideline: ACMG SF v3.2 & Emirati Genome Program Actionability Framework

rules.recommended_action: Schedule specialized preventive cardiology and lipid management consultation
rules.clinical_rationale: Familial Hypercholesterolemia (LDLR pathogenic variant) requires aggressive early lipid-lowering therapy and coronary plaque screening.
rules.source_guideline: DoH Dyslipidemia & Familial Hypercholesterolemia Management Protocol
